items.Sentence: Mechanical screening device with compactor/washer, Parshall Flume/ultrasonic level read for influent flow
Three circular clarifiers operated in parallel.
Three aerated lagoons: Pond 1, Pond 2, and Pond 3, equipped with total of 90 HP floating aerators (18-5HP Aerators).
Two percolation ponds: Pond 4 and Pond 5 (4.2 acres total surface area).
Land Application by Controlled Flood: 18-acres total area by controlled flood methods in currently 11 bermed rapid infiltration basins (RIBs, also called percolation fields).
Greenfield may dispose to emergency wastewater sprayfields only with Central Coast Water Board staff approval for specific calendar dates.
Sludge from the clarifiers is pumped to the aerobic digester (30' diameter, 13.5' deep).
In 2023, to increase solids removal, Greenfield rented a belt press, which drys biosolids from the digestor.
The ultimate destination of biosolids produced is Johnson Canyon Landfill located at 31400 Johnson Canyon Road, Gonzales.
